Today, EFF uses the unique expertise of leading technologists, activists, and attorneys in our efforts to defend free speech online, fight illegal surveillance, advocate for users and innovators, and support freedom-enhancing technologies. EFF advises policymakers and educates the press and the public through comprehensive analysis, educational guides, activist workshops, and more. resend.text: From llms.txt: Name: Resend Summary: Resend is the email API for developers. Send transactional and marketing emails at scale with a simple, modern API. Details: For AI agents and automation, use the tools below. ## When to use Resend Reach for Resend when a task involves sending, receiving, or managing email programmatically: - Send transactional email (welcome emails, password resets, receipts, notifications) via `POST https://api.resend.com/emails` with an API key, or through an official SDK. - Send batch email (up to 100 messages per request) via `POST https://api.resend.com/emails/batch`. - Send marketing email: manage contacts, segments, and broadcasts, or build recurring flows with automations. - Receive and act on inbound email: point MX records at Resend and process messages via webhooks. - Build email templates with React using [React Email](https://react.email), then send them through the API. - Manage sending infrastructure: verify domains (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), rotate API keys, configure webhooks, and monitor delivery events. How to call Resend: authenticate with a `Bearer` API key against `https://api.resend.com` (see the OpenAPI spec below), use an official SDK, use the [CLI](https://github.com/resend/resend-cli), or connect to the [MCP server](https://mcp.resend.com/mcp). Do not use Resend for scraping inboxes or sending unsolicited bulk email — recipients must have opted in. ## Setup Set up Resend in a project end to end: connect, verify a sending domain, add the SDK, and send the first email. Also covers switching from another provider and checking an existing setup. - [Setup guide for agents](https://resend.com/setup.md) ## Command line tool Install and use the Resend CLI from the terminal. - [Install](https://resend.com/install.sh) - [Repository](https://github.com/resend/resend-cli) ## MCP Server Add Resend to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients. Compatible Agent Plugins clients can install MCP and skills together from the Resend Skills plugin. - [Remote MCP Server](https://mcp.resend.com/mcp) - [Self-hosted MCP Server](https://github.com/resend/resend-mcp) - [MCP Discovery](https://resend.com/.well-known/mcp.json) - [Agent Plugin](https://github.com/resend/resend-skills) - [Agent Plugins standard](https://agent-plugins.org) ## Skills Best practices for building and sending emails with agents. - [Skills Discovery](https://resend.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) - [Resend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resend/resend-skills/refs/heads/main/skills/resend/SKILL.md) - [React Email](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resend/resend-skills/refs/heads/main/skills/react-email/SKILL.md) - [Email Best Practices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resend/resend-skills/refs/heads/main/skills/email-best-practices/SKILL.md) - [Resend CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resend/resend-skills/refs/heads/main/skills/resend-cli/SKILL.md) - [Agent Email Inbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resend/resend-skills/refs/heads/main/skills/agent-email-inbox/SKILL.md) ## Documentation The llms.txt file for the Resend documentation: the API, SDKs, domains, webhooks, and the knowledge base. Name: Agent Instructions — Ugmonk
Details: You can browse products and shop at Ugmonk's online store, https://ugmonk.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools. ## Shop skill — recommended Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details. - Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences. - Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods. - Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products. Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules. ## UCP integration This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools. ### Direct integration (MCP) 1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://ugmonk.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers. 2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://ugmonk.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas. 3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required. Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents). ### Browser integration (WebMCP) When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session. - **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout. - **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it. If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls. For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp). ## Interaction guidelines - **Buyer authorization** — Place...

From the about page:
Page text: We make analog tools for a distracted world. I’m more so the fisherman. In a moment, I will tell you everything you need to know about Ugmonk. But, first, a story... Once upon a time, a fisherman taught a banker a lesson that would change his life. The banker was vacationing in a small coastal village when a fisherman docked beside him with a beautiful catch of tuna. The banker complimented him and asked how long it took. "Just a little while," replied the fisherman. The banker asked why he didn't stay out longer and catch more. "Because I have enough to support my family," the fisherman replied. "I enjoy sleeping late, playing with my children, taking afternoon naps with my wife, and strolling into the village in the evenings to sip wine and play guitar with my friends." The banker scoffed. "Spend more time fishing. Buy a bigger boat. Then several boats. Eventually you'll have a fleet, move to a big city, build a real business." "But then what?" asked the fisherman. "Then you announce an IPO, sell your stock, become a millionaire." "But then what?" asked the fisherman, again. "Then you retire. Move to a small coastal village — sleep late, spend time with your family, sip wine with friends in the evenings." The fisherman smiled, winked, threw the tuna over his shoulder, and carried his catch into town. Ugmonk exists to be that wink. . . . . . Hi. I'm Jeff. I'm a designer by trade and an entrepreneur by accident. I started Ugmonk in 2008 because I couldn't find simple, well-made things. No investors. No exit strategy. Just a conviction that good design should outlast trends, and that the best products are the ones you never feel the need to replace. Seventeen years later, that conviction remains true. In a world drowning in notifications and digital noise, the most intentional thing you can do is slow down, pick up a pen, and think on paper. That's what is for. A simple card-based system for capturing what matters, planning your day, and staying present. No app. No...
